thread:
Emma: Quick sync - finalizing run-of-show + inbound demo traffic routing for Tues webinar. Need short checklist and who owns the traffic failover.
Sam: I can own traffic routing and TTL rules. Do we have expected peak concurrent demo sessions?
Emma: Planning for 150 concurrent demo users for live demo. Target latency under 400ms for the sample prompt set.
Jess: Rehearsal notes: we should run a 2-step load test: smoke (10 users) then peak (150). Also confirm fallback flow to smaller model if capacity hits limit.
Nate: For the load test, use the k6 script I pushed to the repo. Command:
```
k6 run loadtests/webinar-demo.js --vus 150 --duration 3m
```
Sam: Copy that. What's the fallback model id and where is routing policy defined?
Emma: Fallback model: redwood-lite-v1. Routing policy in `infra/traffic/policies.yaml` - I updated the canary weights. Jess, can you validate the user-facing messaging for fallback?
Jess: Yep. I'll add a single-line toast: "We're routing to a lower-latency model to keep the demo responsive - outputs may be slightly different." Keep it short.
Ava: I'll own the backstage cueing and live chat prompts. For leads: capture session_id + email and route to HubSpot via webhook. Make sure we don't send PII in plain text.
Sam: Will set a rate limit on the webhook and add retry logic. Suggest 5s backoff, 5 retries. Also will add header `X-Env: webinar-stage` for filtering.
Nate: Deploy-bot shows latest deploys for staging env:
deploy-bot: "staging: inference-runtime v2.8.1 deployed at 2026-03-18T09:12Z - smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:"
Emma: Perfect. Run-of-show (short):
```
00:00 - Intro panel (5m)
05:00 - Live demo prep (2m)
07:00 - Demo 1: low-latency routing (8m)
15:00 - Demo 2: cost/throughput profile + Q&A (10m)
25:00 - Closing + CTA (5m)
```
Emma: Action owners: Sam (traffic + webhook), Jess (copy + fallback message), Nate (load test + infra), Ava (backstage + lead routing). Rehearsal window: Mon 16:00 PT. Everyone ok?
Sam: Good for me :thumbsup:
Jess: I'll be there.
Nate: Confirmed.
Ava: Confirmed.
Emma: Great - I'll share calendar invite and the rehearsal checklist (short). Also attaching the rehearsal deck link: https://drive.redwood.ai/webinar/rehearsal-deck
Sam: One more ask - please share the prompt set we'll use so I can tune batching/quantization profiles before the run.
Emma: Sending prompts in the rehearsal doc now. Thanks team! :rocket:
